trend: Bengaluru filter coffee goes from Rs 20 to Rs 25; the Rs 150 work-from-cafe latte debate
why: Bengaluru coffee prices are local news this month and our audience lives in that city.
text:
Filter coffee in Bengaluru is now ₹25, and a café latte is ₹150 if you nurse it for four hours.

A weekday morning with SILT is one stick in water: 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine, 5 g fibre, D3, K2, B12. About ₹60 a day. Keep the filter coffee for Sundays.
